subject: german
title: Wider Family

walkthroughs.body_html: Der Onkel = uncle. Die Tante = aunt. Cousins: der Cousin (m), die Cousine (f). Borrowed from French.
Die Familie = the family. 'Meine Familie ist gross' = 'My family is big'. Meine (my, feminine) — see possessives next.
